require 'yaml'
require 'json'
workflow = YAML.load_file('.github/workflows/ci.yml')
job = workflow.fetch('jobs').fetch('workspace')
actual = job.fetch('strategy').fetch('matrix').fetch('include')
expected = [
  {'runner'=>'ubuntu-24.04','host'=>'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu','binary'=>'target/debug/xrai'},
  {'runner'=>'macos-15','host'=>'aarch64-apple-darwin','binary'=>'target/debug/xrai'},
  {'runner'=>'windows-2025','host'=>'x86_64-pc-windows-msvc','binary'=>'target/debug/xrai.exe'}
]
raise 'wrong native matrix' unless actual == expected
raise 'wrong shell' unless job.fetch('defaults').fetch('run').fetch('shell') == 'bash'
steps = job.fetch('steps').select { |step| step.key?('run') }.map { |step| step.fetch('run') }
['cargo fmt --all -- --check', 'cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings', 'cargo test --workspace --locked', 'cargo build --workspace --locked', '"./$XRAI_BINARY" --help', '"./$XRAI_BINARY" --version'].each do |command|
  raise "missing #{command}" unless steps.include?(command)
end
raise 'missing host guard' unless steps.any? { |step| step.include?('EXPECTED_HOST') && step.include?('test ') }
puts JSON.pretty_generate({'result'=>'passed', 'matrix'=>actual, 'locked_build_lint_test'=>true, 'native_host_guard'=>true, 'scope'=>'configuration validation only; remote jobs not executed'})
